purpose: Execute the exact expansion unlocked by the passed eager-MTP2 sensitive parent: one full MTP2 qualification followed, only if it passes, by exactly one eager-MTP4 short actual.

frozen_interpretation.mtp2: A fresh-cache, fresh-output 25-prompt natural-EOS short benchmark plus the complete quality battery, nonzero acceptance, and exact all-prompt target-oracle equality.
frozen_interpretation.mtp4: Exactly one fresh-cache, fresh-output short actual. To maximize useful coverage without adding another actual, the single MTP4 server run includes the same full 25-prompt benchmark and full quality battery, plus nonzero acceptance and exact all-prompt target-oracle equality.
frozen_interpretation.speed_policy: Speed is recorded but never decides correctness, support, quarantine, or whether a historical result is preserved.
frozen_interpretation.context_policy: The short suite remains outside the numeric active_context_tokens axis and max-model-len 32768 is not an active-context measurement.

stages.workload: 25 cold unique prompts, natural EOS, max 512, returned token IDs; complete quality battery

stages.actual_count_contract: This is the campaign's one and only eager-MTP4 actual. It may use rN only if no earlier E2 output or cache exists; after any E2 evidence exists, another MTP4 launch requires a new preregistration.
stages.workload: 25 cold unique prompts, natural EOS, max 512, returned token IDs; complete quality battery

launch_policy.acknowledgement: Exact per-stage ACK required before any preflight or launch.
launch_policy.git_at_launch: Require a clean worktree on main with HEAD equal to cached and live origin/main.
launch_policy.git_after_launch: Require local HEAD, branch, and worktree unchanged. Query and record live origin movement, but remote movement after launch is non-gating.
launch_policy.storage: Every stage and retry uses a nonexistent output and cache on ext4. No resume and no overwrite.
launch_policy.cleanup: Before and after each stage: no running container, selected port free, no vLLM/llama process, no render-node owner; acquire the host and GPU0 locks.
launch_policy.attempts: Every attempt is immutable. E1 retries use a new rN root, cache, and port. E2 may select an rN identity only before its first launch; any existing E2 output or cache closes the one-actual authorization.

protected_speed_evidence.rule: No expansion result overwrites or lowers any historical value.

publication_rule: A passed stage is measured short-suite evidence only. It fills no numeric active-context point. Failed or quarantined attempts remain durable and speed never changes correctness classification.
